title: Spicy Jamaican Prawn Gratin
description: A tropical twist on the classic gratin, featuring succulent prawns in a spicy Jamaican sauce.
instructions: Season the prawns with salt, pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Dredge the prawns in flour, shaking off excess.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped tiger prawns and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the prawns to a baking dish.
Mix the grated cheese with the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter.
Pour the cheese mixture over the prawns.
Sprinkle with chopped cilantro and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve hot with a side of spicy Jamaican sauce (recipe below).
Combine 1/4 cup of chopped red chili, 2 cloves of minced garlic, and 2 tablespoons of lime juice in a small bowl.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of honey and 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh cilantro.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the spicy Jamaican sauce over the prawn gratin.
